info.name: Invoice Process - API Verification
info.description:
API contract derived from InvoiceController:
  POST /api/invoices/extract  (multipart/form-data, field "file") -> 201 InvoiceResponse
  GET  /api/invoices/{id}                                         -> 200 InvoiceResponse

SAFE to run repeatedly (no Gemini call, no database write): folders 01, 03, 04, 05, 07.
Folder 09 is also a safe GET, but needs the id stored by folder 08.
Folders 02 and 08 each make ONE real Gemini Free Tier call and insert a new invoice. Run them manually, once.
Every invoice response now includes a tokenUsage object (null fields for invoices stored before this feature).
Do NOT run the whole collection in a loop / with iterations > 1.

File paths are relative: set Postman Settings > General > Working directory to the project folder.
The PDF fixtures (postman/fixtures/*, samples/*) are NOT included in the repository: provide your own synthetic
files under those names. oversized.pdf must be larger than 10 MB.

The Gemini API key is NOT needed here and must never be stored in Postman: the backend owns it.

Folder 10 (corrections & version history): 10b WRITES a new invoice version - run it manually. Every other request in folder 10 is read-only or rejected before any write.

CSRF: "GET login page" stores the XSRF-TOKEN cookie in the collection variable xsrfToken; every non-GET request
sends it as X-XSRF-TOKEN. This collection has not been run against a running application yet, so this is unverified.

Run "00 - Login" first (set adminEmail/adminPassword in the environment). Folders 02 and 08 call LIVE Gemini and 10b writes data: run them only manually, with approval.

item.name: 06 - FAILURE - Provider Scenarios (verified by automated tests)
item.description:
These cannot be triggered from Postman without wasting Free Tier quota or breaking the running app,
so they are verified by the JUnit suite (mvnw clean test), with Gemini and the service mocked:

- Gemini HTTP 500 -> InvoiceExtractionException -> 502, provider text not leaked
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.providerFailureBecomesExtractionException
    InvoiceControllerTest.providerFailureReturns502
- Gemini HTTP 429 (quota) -> clear 502 message
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.rateLimitGivesClearMessage
- Missing GEMINI_API_KEY -> 502 without calling Gemini
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.missingApiKeyFailsWithoutCallingGemini
- Gemini answer is not valid invoice JSON -> 502
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.nonJsonAnswerBecomesExtractionException
- LLM values fail validation -> 422, invoice stored as FAILED, never EXTRACTED
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.invalidLlmDataIsNeverStoredAsExtracted
    InvoiceControllerTest.validationFailureReturns422
- Unexpected exception -> 500 with a generic message, no internals
    InvoiceControllerTest.unexpectedErrorReturns500WithoutInternals

Never hammer Gemini to force a real 429.

Added for multi-page + token usage (all mocked, no Gemini call):
- usageMetadata + modelVersion read from the SAME response, exactly one request
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.readsInvoiceAndUsageMetadataFromTheSameResponse
- missing/partial usageMetadata -> null fields, valid invoice still succeeds, total not recomputed
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.missingUsageMetadataDoesNotFailAValidExtraction
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.absentOptionalCountsStayNullAndTotalIsNotRecomputed
- unusable answer keeps the tokens used; HTTP error has none
    GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest.unusableAnswerStillReportsTheTokensThatWereUsed
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.unparseableAnswerKeepsTheTokenUsageFromTheException
- page-2-only item persisted; GET returns the persisted tokenUsage
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.persistsEveryPageItemAndTheTokenUsage
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.getReturnsExactlyThePersistedTokenUsage
- page-2 item missing -> subtotal mismatch -> 422, FAILED (tokens kept)
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.missingPage2ItemIsRejectedByTheSubtotalCheck
    InvoiceServiceImplTest.validationFailureKeepsTheTokenUsage
- JSON contract: tokenUsage field names, nulls for old invoices, no raw LLM/provider data
    InvoiceControllerTest.postReturnsTokenUsageNextToTheExistingFields
    InvoiceControllerTest.historicalInvoiceSerializesNullTokenFields
